medSchoolStudLife.diversity:
Our collective goal is to be conscious of diversity, reinforced with equity and excellence through inclusion, nondiscrimination, and pluralism for all members.
The UCC welcomes and supports all people, encompassing the various characteristics of persons in our community. This commitment extends beyond a set of ideas or nondiscrimination policies. We actively promote a safe and supportive environment and foster a community that embraces and celebrates all. Consequently, the UCC is committed to ensuring a place free from discrimination for every applicant in all categories protected by applicable local and federal laws.
medSchoolStudLife.leaveOfAbsence: A LOA is available upon request. Students in each academic year will be evaluated base on specific requirements.

medSchoolCurriculum.clinicalRotations: Clinical rotations begin in third year.
medSchoolCurriculum.curricularHighlights: The medical curriculum is organized in 2 years of pre-clinical and 2 years of clinical experiences. A longitudinal curriculum in bioethics and humanities in medicine characterizes the medical education program. Clinical correlations are included in the basic science courses. Exposure to real and standardized patients is provided beginning with the 1st. Introduction to clinical medicine has as its foundation the biopsychosocial model. A problem-based course is structured around prevalent problems encountered in primary care. The 3rd learning experience revolves around required clerkship in internal medicine, pediatrics, obstetrics-gynecology, general surgery, and family medicine. The latter takes place in the ambulatory setting. Also, during the 3rd, students enroll in the surgical sub-specialties and psychiatry clerkship. Eighteen weeks of electives are provided in the fourth year, plus 3 months in required courses in neurology, ambulatory medicine, selected topics.
medSchoolCurriculum.primaryCarePrograms: The UCC SoM is committed to strengthen the primary services by promoting along all the curriculum and community activities primary care specialties.  In the past four years 56% or more of our students MATCHED in primary care related field residencies.

medSchoolInformation.generalInformation: The UCC-SOM was founded in 1976 as a nonprofit private institution chartered under the laws of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. The basic sciences building, library, animal house, and central administration was inaugurated in 1990 adjacent to Dr. Ramon Ruiz Arnau University Hospital, which serves as the principal teaching hospital. The school facilities are located in a 56-acre academic health center in the city of Bayamon.
medSchoolInformation.missionStatement: To form competent health professionals with excellent academic preparation within a humanistic and holistic framework. Our guiding principle is to ensure that our graduates possess a strong sense of professionalism and commitment to their social duties, respecting the dignity of all human beings.

(If you need a sample letter template you can find it on the institutional website)

medSchoolApplication.interviewFormat: The interviews of the program are in a Multiple Mini- Interview format through the Teams platform (MMI).  The purpose of the interview is to collect information concerning the qualities of those applicants selected for an interview.

medSchoolApplication.courseworkAcceptanceInfo: For courses to be accepted, the candidate has to transfer and finish all required courses at a four-year undergraduate institution.
medSchoolApplication.letterOfIntentAdditionalInfo: If after submitting the AMCAS application, the student has obtained recognition or had significant academic, community, etc. experiences they can send official documents as evidence of this to the Admissions Office to be added to their file.
medSchoolApplication.technicalStandardInfo: Universidad Central del Caribe School of Medicine Technical Standards define the non-academic abilities required for admission, progression, and graduation from the MD program. These standards emphasize patient safety, ethical conduct, emotional stability, professionalism, and the capacity to function independently in diverse and often stressful clinical environments. Medical students must demonstrate adequate intellectual, communication, observational, and motor skills to provide safe and effective patient care in both English and Spanish. All students must meet these standards consistently to remain in good standing.

medSchoolFinancial.financialAid: The Office of financial aid provides counseling to all students. Students could qualify for pertinent federal and commonwealth scholarships and loan programs. The UCC have in place scholarships based on academic merit and need. Every year other the UCC work on identifying additional financial assistance with community organizations, alumni, among other sources.

medSchoolSelection.premedReqRec: Required: General Biology, General or Inorganic Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, General Physics, College Mathematics, English, Spanish, Behavioral Sciences, and Social Sciences* *(Coursework must be in Sociology, Psychology, Economics, or Anthropology).  Highly recommended courses: Biochemistry, Human Anatomy, Genetics, Molecular and Cell Biology, Psychology.  Being bilingual in Spanish and English is required.
medSchoolSelection.oldestPrereqDate: Six years or less is recommended.
medSchoolSelection.selectionFactors: The selection of candidates for admission is made exclusively by the Admissions Committee. The admission process is free from discrimination for every applicant in all categories protected by applicable local and federal laws. Applicants must be bilingual in Spanish and English. Major factors considered in the selection of candidates for admission include undergraduate academic record, overall GPA and science GPA, performance in all areas of the MCAT, community services, research, and other experiences, results of a personal interview, and letters of recommendation. Participation in MMI interviews is required before consideration for admission. All interviews are arranged by the Office of Admissions and are conducted at the medical school facilities in Bayamon or remotely (subject to a decision of the admission committee).
medSchoolSelection.preMedShadowText: Research, shadowing, leadership and community service experiences are recommended.
